name: desert-of-desolation
description: Desert of Desolation alpha.40: guarded action submission, recoverable drafts and receipts, verified save reads, safe scene media and a tested native transaction adapter. Live Site publication remains separate.

interface.longDescription: Preserves the existing campaign, audio, media, audience and default prompts while adding alpha.40 source safeguards: bounded save reads, duplicate-action prevention, session draft recovery, uncertainty receipts, safe art selection and bounded checkpoint copying. The transaction adapter requires native authentication and durable storage; this release does not claim a deployed Site or a completed rules engine.
defaultPrompt: Start Desert of Desolation from the packaged campaign state with mobile-first presentation and predictive preload.
Resume Desert of Desolation and prepare the current integrated node knowledge, legal nearby interactions, spoiler-safe media cues, and mobile-friendly narration.
